review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: About The Role The IT Systems Administrator runs Epic's day-to-day IT operations and keeps them continuously audit-ready and in compliance with defined regulatory requirements. As the dedicated IT function of a small company, you will work from goals and requirements set by technology leadership, with wide ownership of how the work gets done. What You'll Do Administer corporate identity and access across Google Workspace and our core business applications -- accounts, groups, roles, and least-privilege permissions Evolve the identity stack -- single sign-on, lifecycle automation, and identity tooling as needs grow Own the user lifecycle end to end -- provisioning at hire, changes at role transitions, and complete, timely deprovisioning at exit Run periodic user access reviews across in-scope systems and drive the remediation they surface to closure Enforce authentication and device stand
